capabilities: Hide metadata properties whose value is empty
Keep specific properties visible even when empty
Hide specific properties in the properties table and side dock
Match properties by prefix using a trailing wildcard
Temporarily show all properties while editing metadata
disambiguation: It only changes how properties are displayed in the interface; it does not delete or modify property values.
extras: Installable through BRAT or by manually copying main.js and manifest.json; includes build instructions for developers.
intentEvidence: Keep hiding specific metadata properties even if they are not empty in properties table / file properties (side dock)
problem: Obsidian always displays metadata properties in the properties view and side dock, including empty ones, which clutters the interface.
summary: Hides empty or selected metadata properties from the properties view, side dock, and properties table in Obsidian.
